correctness.rationale: For every n≥2, parity-invariant rank proves even n≥4 nonsynchronizing, and direct n=2,3 checks handle exceptions. For odd n≥5 an explicit W_k maps Q to singleton and has exactly \(2k^2-k+1\) letters. The inverse-image formula for every nonempty cyclic interval and the piecewise potential P prove \(P(c^{-1}I)\le P(I)+1\) for both letters in all parity/wrap/seam/length boundary cases, forcing every reset word to be at least P(Q). Embedded independent subset BFS n=2..19, witness replay odd n≤151, and 347214 potential-edge checks corroborate the proof; finite checks alone are not the infinite argument.
